verdict.rationale: Live collaboration is a fair question for a work-management platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents board or item changes appearing instantly in teammates' open sessions without a refresh. The only related item (monday-docs-27) describes developer event subscriptions for running backend workflows when data changes, which is a building block rather than the user-facing live-sync capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing

citations.quote: Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
